basic_info.description: After 52 years, this beloved Parkside residence is ready for its next chapter! Lovingly maintained and recently refreshed, this sun-drenched corner lot, 3-bedroom, 1.25-bath home blends classic charm with modern touches. A formal entry leads you upstairs, where a skylight and expansive windows invite natural light to pour in. Gleaming newly refinished and installed hardwood floors throughout, while the living room fireplace creates a cozy ambiance. The open flow leads to a bright dining area and a beautifully updated eat-in kitchen, complete with brand new Quartz countertops, a new range & hood, and stylish finishes. Three spacious bedrooms, plus a newly refreshed bathroom with new flooring, vanity & fixtures, plus a separate tub and stall shower complete the upper level. Downstairs, a versatile bonus space is perfect for a media room, office, or gym, with a convenient quarter bath and direct access to the backyard. The reimagined newly landscaped outdoor space features a covered patio and fresh new turf lawn. A large 2-car garage with expansion potential, ample storage and laundry area completes this wonderful corner home. Situated just minutes to Lake Merced Park and Fort Funston for scenic hikes and trails, the SF Zoo, multiple golf courses, and Stonestown Shopping Center!
